entities.name: Anton Bezenšek
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anton Bezenšek was a Slovene linguist, journalist, shorthand expert, and lecturer, who spent most of his life in Bulgaria. He is known as the scholar who adapted the Gabelsberger shorthand system to the South Slavic languages.
